item.title: Alpes-Maritimes firm RedFX joins global ocean cleanup initiative
item.description: The company partners with 4ocean to help remove over 5,700 kilograms of plastic from oceans and coastlines, including the Mediterranean waters off the French Riviera.

item.title: Monaco United Women secure three more wins in their unbeaten streak
item.description: Monaco United Women's football secured a commanding 6-0 victory against Villeneuve-Loubet at the Stade Dider-Deschamps on Sunday 8th February, completing a three-win streak without conceding a goal.

item.title: Guillaume Ranvier appointed General Manager of Hôtel Hermitage Monte-Carlo
item.description: The new General Manager arrives from Four Seasons George V in Paris as the historic palace prepares to unveil renovated suites and a new bar.

item.title: Monaco Government responds to Fontvieille Shopping Centre strike
item.description: The Monaco Government has promised to continue dialogue with traders following Monday's strike at the Fontvieille Shopping Centre, where approximately 80% of shops closed their doors in protest.

item.title: France launches largest military exercise since the Cold War
item.description: The three-month drill involves 12,000 troops and tests French forces' readiness for high-intensity warfare, with air operations beginning this week.

item.title: Civil War drama The Gray House launches on Prime Video following Monaco premiere
item.description: The eight-episode limited series, which opened the 63rd Monte-Carlo Television Festival in June 2024, arrives on the streaming platform on 26th February.

item.title: Belle Époque palace Como Le Beauvallon returns with Yannick Alléno at the helm
item.description: The Michelin-starred chef behind Monaco's Pavyllon Monte-Carlo and L'LAbysse will open a new restaurant at the Belle Époque hotel near Saint Tropez when it debuts in April.

item.title: WAIB Summit Monaco set to return in June
item.description: The WAIB Summit Monaco, a major conference focused on Web3 technology and artificial intelligent, is scheduled to return from 9th to 10th June 2026 at One Monte Carlo.

item.title: How to spend Saint Valentine’s Day in Monaco
item.description: With Valentine's Day falling on Saturday this year, couples in Monaco have the luxury of a full day to celebrate. Whether it's a romantic candlelit dinner with Mediterranean views or a simple stroll through the old town, the Principality has much to offer.

item.title: Arnaud Alessandria finishes 30th in Super-G at Milano Cortina 2026
item.description: Monaco's Arnaud Alessandria finished 30th in the men's Super-G at the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics, crossing the line 4.81 seconds behind gold medalist Franjo von Allmen of Switzerland.
